question: In 2025 news, Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS) primarily impacts which part of the human body system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Peripheral nervous system**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS)** primarily affects the **Peripheral Nervous System**, which is responsible for transmitting signals between the brain, spinal cord, and the rest of the body.
 
• GBS is an **autoimmune disorder** where the body's immune system mistakenly attacks the peripheral nerves, leading to symptoms like weakness, tingling, and, in severe cases, paralysis.
